title: Stawamus/Indian River FSR
source_text: Stawamus/Indian River FSR: August 30, 2024 - December 31, 2026: Road closed to all users at gate at 3km due to construction activities. Expect delays 0 - 3km. Access through Indian Arm not permitted. See Forest Service Road Conditions in the Sea to Sky District for more details on the above closures.
